scopeCorrection.warning: The Hunterpedia-derived corpus is not exhaustive visual coverage and may contain voyage-era context that is not evidence about the Black Whale itself.
scopeCorrection.requiredReplacement: A page-by-page, panel-by-panel, ship-only review of lawful primary chapter pages.
scopeCorrection.shipOnlyRule: Retain only evidence about the Black Whale as a vessel, spatial system, operating environment, route network, access system, structural object, scale reference, or chapter-dependent operational state.

primarySourceRequirement.publicStorageRule: Do not commit manga pages or scans. Store only hashes, page/panel locators, derived observations, certainty, contradictions, and modeling permissions.

completionPolicy.reason: No chapter may be marked visually reviewed until its lawful primary pages have been inspected twice. Hunterpedia remains a cross-check, not the complete visual source.
